description_en: Invokes the DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory operation to query the scheduling node information of an auto provisioning group
description_zh: 调用 DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory 查询弹性供应组的调度任务信息
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-auto-provisioning-group-history --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-provisioning-group-id apg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoProvisioningGroupHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the auto provisioning group resides
parameters.help_zh: 弹性供应组所在地域的ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the current page in a paged query. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询的当前页码。起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the auto provisioning group
parameters.name: auto_provisioning_group_id

parameters.help_en: The start time for querying the scheduling history. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询调度历史的起始时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for querying the scheduling history. Specify the time in the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询调度历史的结束时间。按照https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html标准表示，并使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time
